name: Web Page Import
description: File > Import > Web Page: fetches a page with its pictures and keeps the article (without menus, adverts and comment sections) as a text document to edit and annotate, or as a read-only web page document. A preview shows what will be imported. Web links dragged from a browser onto the binder, corkboard or outliner are imported the same way. The page's address becomes a bookmark of the document, author and date go into its notes. Brings Qt's TLS plugin for secure (https) pages; uses the system's OpenSSL 3.
author: Quillbinder
